scope: Explicit Intel VM86/VME transitions and events, retained IRET/RETF/VM86 far-transfer accesses across backing suspension, and MPX in protected code16 and VM86. All generated NeverC programs use host-x64 source targets.
return_build_note: The initial return-journal builds began at 9ae495beec; d1363decbd added only the namespace closing comment while they compiled. The final integration builds and tests above use one clean validated source commit.

qualification_boundary.native_vm86: Original IRETD/VM86/protected-handler instruction streams run through KVM on both core classes. Four added streams qualify OSXSAVE-disabled MPX only. The original instruction matrix records its comparison count in each report. Only page-table A/D timing is excluded from full RAM comparison.
qualification_boundary.task_switch: VMX task-switch exits are KVM software reference evidence, not physical task-switch qualification.
qualification_boundary.enabled_mpx: SDM-derived software contracts; this host has no enabled physical MPX bank. Tables retain flat DS; VM86 tables retain the 64 KiB DS limit. Unknown or unsupported inputs fail explicitly.
qualification_boundary.return_suspension: Host backing stops have no direct CPU oracle. The failing-then-passing PTE/IP alias reproducer, retained CPU/binding checks, watchpoint/TF handoff and generated-source budgets qualify this runtime contract.
qualification_boundary.sgx: See x86-sgx-runner-discovery-2026-11-09.json. The user-supplied GitHub runners expose no usable SGX EPC/device and execute no enclave instructions.
remaining: Real/protected/IA-32e mode transitions with a unified full-width live machine state
Software SMM save-area/return and SGX EPCM/SSA/AEX ownership
Unbound asynchronous producers and remaining original-machine state banks
Physical enabled MPX, AMX, HLE/RTM, FRED, UINTR, SNP and unowned xstate qualification

initial_mpx_focus.resolution: Both SDKs exposed the same two test defects: a guest fetch #PF was incorrectly expected to consume no attempt, and the native VM86 fixture retained the prior case debug binding without its debug bank. Commit 65842a09e8 corrected the assertion and reset each case binding. The implementation was unchanged; both corrected focused runs and the final matrix pass.
